pages.authors.col.author: Author
pages.authors.heading: Authors
pages.authors.howTo: Click a name to open the author's profile on the host; click elsewhere in the row to filter every view to that author, again to clear. Click a column's name to sort by it, again to turn the order round.
pages.authors.howToMany: A name that recurs across projects is one row with the sums; a name an export anonymized (author-1) says nothing across projects and stays a row per project.
pages.authors.noGit: No Git repository — nothing to attribute.
pages.authors.sortBy.author: Sort by author
pages.authors.sub: Git authors of the entries — who created, touched, or superseded what, in every project this page holds: this one, its family, the friends in the graph, the path. Git knows names, not who was driving.

pages.details.linkedAfterWhy: This entry is in question ({status}); these later entries are linked after it — check whether they depend on it.

pages.findings.sub: keep-the-why-lint {linter} · {errors} error(s), {warnings} warning(s) · structure only, never content
pages.lookup.family: Looking for {uuid} in the family's published exports…
pages.lookup.familyNone: No entry with Id {uuid} in this export, nor in the family's published exports.
pages.lookup.live: Looking for {uuid} in the other projects known here…
pages.lookup.liveNone: No entry with Id {uuid} in this project, nor in any other project known here. A family member that is not checked out can be cloned or cached — see Family.
pages.overview.shallow: · shallow clone (dates are the clone's edge)
pages.queues.heading: Queues
pages.queues.needsReviewWhy: Status: needs-review — a Revisit-when trigger fired and nobody re-checked yet.
pages.queues.openWhy: Status: open — the entry's central question has no answer yet.
pages.queues.pendingWhy: Written in an unattended session where a question would have been asked; never confirmed by anyone.
pages.queues.revisitWhy: The conditions on record. Whether one has fired is a human judgement; the dashboard cannot tell.
pages.queues.sub: What needs a person. The dashboard lists; it does not decide.
pages.queues.unknownWhy: Where the claim came from could not be traced — on any entry still in force, an open question included: Evidence and Status are separate axes. A maintainer can often settle these in a minute.
pages.ref.stale: · Id not found here — the locator may be stale
pages.refs.familyMissing: {n:family member} not available here — not looked through.
pages.refs.familyNone: No references to this entry from the rest of the family.
pages.refs.familyScope: References from the rest of the family show with the family scope — the switch next to the project menu.
pages.refs.looking: Looking for references from the rest of the family…
pages.refs.seenFromFamily: Referenced by (See), elsewhere in the family
